patients.summary: Healthy high school math teacher who joined in 2022. Evaluated by an outside gynecology office in 2024 for unexplained infertility (normal workup, two clomiphene cycles, normal clomiphene challenge test), with mild dysmenorrhea; treatment paused. One ED visit in January 2026 for left lower quadrant pain that settled.

documents.title: New patient call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is looking for a new primary care doctor; her old office is closing its adult panel at the end of the school year and she would rather move now. 26 y/o, teaches high school math, BCBS PPO verified. No current concerns, would like a physical. Booked new patient preventive visit 5/10 at 3:45 (after school dismissal per her request). Records release form emailed for her prior office.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
26-year-old woman establishing care. Moving over from her previous primary care office; release signed, records requested.

Feels well, no complaints. Periods come regularly, roughly monthly, nothing she considers abnormal. No chronic medical problems, no hospitalizations, no surgeries. Takes nothing daily, no supplements.

Allergies: no known drug allergies.

Family: mother with hypothyroidism on treatment; father has hypertension; maternal grandmother had type 2 diabetes. Nobody she knows of with fertility trouble, endometriosis or early menopause.

Social: married. Teaches math at a high school. Has never smoked, does not drink. Walks most evenings.

ROS negative across systems.

Exam: well-appearing, in no distress. Vitals as charted, BMI in the normal range. HEENT normal, thyroid not enlarged, no nodules. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses. Skin without rashes. Extremities warm, no swelling. Mood and affect appropriate. PHQ-2 0.

Assessment/plan:
1. Adult preventive care. Healthy. Baseline CBC, CMP, lipids. One-time HIV and hepatitis C screening, she agrees.
2. Cervical screening: reports a normal Pap last year at her prior office; will confirm when records come and plan the next one for 2024-25.
3. Vaccines: believes Tdap was within the last several years and HPV done as a kid. Will reconcile with outside records. Flu shot in the fall.

Follow up in a year for a physical.

documents.title: Your recent lab work
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Nicole, everything from your visit came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, cholesterol, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were both negative. Nothing to do for now. Nice meeting you.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
32 pages received by fax from patient's previous PCP. Abstracted:
- Preventive visits yearly 2016-2021, unremarkable.
- Pap 2021: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
- Immunizations: HPV x3 (2008-2009), Tdap 06/2017, COVID Pfizer primary series 2021 plus booster 11/2021.
- No problem list entries, no medications, NKDA.
Immunizations entered into our record. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Outside records review
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Prior records reviewed. Nothing of note. Pap 2021 normal, next due 2024. Tdap good until 2027.

documents.title: Vaccine administration
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here after school for her seasonal vaccines. Feeling well, no fever. Influenza IM left deltoid; bivalent COVID booster IM right deltoid. VIS given. Waited 15 minutes, no reaction.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam. School is out for the summer and she is enjoying the break.

Interval: no illnesses, no new medications. She and her husband stopped using contraception and started trying for a pregnancy about a month ago. Cycles regular. Asks what is normal in terms of how long it takes; reviewed that most couples conceive within a year, sooner to evaluate if cycles become irregular.

Allergies: none to medications.
Family and social history unchanged. Never smoker, no alcohol.

Exam: healthy-appearing. Vitals reviewed. Neck supple, thyroid normal. Cardiac exam normal. Lungs clear. Abdomen benign. No edema. Normal affect, PHQ-2 0.

A/P:
1. Preventive care: CBC and CMP today. Lipids normal last year, not repeating.
2. Trying to conceive: reassurance as above; check in at her next physical or sooner if a year passes.
3. Pap due next year.

RTC 1 year.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs from your physical are all normal. Enjoy the summer!

documents.title: Vaccine administration
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Flu and 2023-24 COVID vaccine given, one in each arm. Denies illness today. Pt asked if the vaccines are fine while trying to get pregnant; reassured both are recommended. Tolerated without issue.
